messages:
Maria D.: Quick follow-up from the playground usability pass. New mock attached (link: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/play-history-2.png). Goals: make tool/schema context visible during live runs, compress run-list rows, and fix a11y focus/announce behavior.

AJ: I like the compact row idea. Proposal: single-line summary with an interactive chevron. Example:
```
▸ 2026-03-19 14:12 — ExtractEntities (success) — 450 tokens — 320ms
```
Chevron keyboard target should be first tabbable element in the row. Expand reveals call args, schema diff, and streaming log.

Samir: Small copy note: change header label from "Function defs" to "Tool definitions" and toolbar button from "Examples" -> "Tool examples & schema". Less technical language for new users.

Lee: A11y checklist:
- Chevron must have aria-expanded and a visible focus ring (not just color).
- Streaming tokens region: `aria-live="polite"` only. Metadata updates (status, duration) must not re-announce.
- Status chips fail WCAG contrast at small sizes; increase weight or add outline.

AJ: Implementation detail: compute a lightweight summary server-side (model, tool count, top-level keys) so we avoid building full DOM for each run. For expands, fetch details on demand or progressively hydrate.

Maria D.: UX question: inline mini-example vs modal for the schema editor. My thought: show a single-line example inline and a ".more" modal with full JSON Schema and sample payloads.

Samir: Agree. Modal CTA should be explicit: primary button text "Insert example". Keep "Apply" for other contexts but avoid ambiguity here.

Lee: Keyboard shortcuts: `/` focus prompt, `k` focus history search, `e` expand focused run (or Enter). Add an accessible legend in help overlay so screen readers can read shortcuts.

DesignBot: Auto-a11y scan: 4 issues found — low contrast on chips, missing aria-live on streaming area in current build, chevron buttons missing accessible name, missing descriptive label for "Insert example" button. Report: https://ci.redwood.dev/a11y/1868129999-report

AJ: UX detail: when expanded, show pretty schema by default with a small "View raw" toggle that switches to a raw JSON block. For the pretty view, expose headings for each field so screen readers can navigate.

Samir: Also add a tiny "insert sample" inline control next to each example snippet so users can one-click paste into the editor. That control must have aria-label="Insert sample: <brief name>".

Lee: For screen readers, ensure raw block is `role=region aria-label="Raw schema"` and the pretty view uses semantic lists/definition lists. Also ensure that dynamic insertion into the editor sets focus inside the editor and announces "Example inserted" politely.

Maria D.: Action items and owners:
- AJ: build collapsed-row prototype + progressive hydrate (due Fri)
- Lee: PR for aria-live/scoped announcements + focus ring + contrast changes (due Thu)
- Samir: copy pass for toolbar/modal/button labels (+ small PR) (due Wed)
- Maria: wire up examples API and sample library demo (ETA end of week)

AJ: I'll drop a short Loom once prototype is up. Any objections to the chevron-first-tab stop pattern?

Samir: No objections. Also propose micro-interaction: when expanding a run that was generating streaming output, auto-scroll streaming region into view and pin the schema sidebar.

Lee: Fine, but ensure focus management so screen reader users don't lose context. If auto-scroll occurs, set focus to the streaming region container afterwards.

Maria D.: Great — collating notes for Monday's design review at 9am. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
